name: AN/TPQ-53 counterfire target acquisition radar on the FMTV M1083-series 6x6 (armoured cab), working pose

published.source: M1083A1P2 FMTV 5-ton MTV published 7.27 m x 2.44 m, 395/85R20 tyres (1.18 m) - as js/hero/us_tpq53.js header. The 7.27 m is not gated: the model's 7.31 m X extent runs from the bumper face 3.62 (plus its tow eyes and the frame horns) to the pintle -3.65, and the figure does not say whether the pintle counts. The array's size is not published.

engine_contract.rows: nato_e00_radarv (js/eras.js, tan coat e00) and radarv_n (js/rules.js, green coat e20) are both built by HeroTpq53.build(THREE, M, C, variant) in js/hero/us_tpq53.js; radarv_n is first assigned in js/units3d_salvage.js and overwritten here (last wins)
engine_contract.current_nodes: 'hull' group; three 'roadwheel' groups (one axle each, origin on the axle, render3d spins each about local Y); one 'turret' group (turntable centre on the housing roof, array face along +X at rest, trained by render3d; radar has no weapon)
engine_contract.len_rule: UNIT_MODELS[key].len = HeroTpq53.len = 7.31 = the measured X extent

must_show: the FMTV armoured cab: a tall square shell over the front axle, cab face x 3.46, back x 1.25, roof z 3.04, chamfered front corners with small quarter windows at x 3.25, y +-1.16
two separate raked armoured windscreens in thick frames between z 2.06 and 2.78 at x 3.43 .. 3.32, the brow over them at z 2.86 .. 2.92 with three amber marker lamps each side at y +-0.60 .. +-0.94
the grille band (x 3.46 .. 3.50, z 1.40 .. 1.88) and the deep bumper x 3.42 .. 3.62, z 0.66 .. 1.06 with its lamps and tow eyes
the rounded door window on each cab side x 1.99 .. 3.02, z 2.08 .. 2.77, the mirror heads on long arms out to y +-1.56 at x 3.42 .. 3.50, the round convex mirror under each head
three axles with single big tyres: x 2.40 (under the cab), -0.94 and -2.26 (the tandem), tyre radius 0.59, track y +-1.02
the spare wheel standing upright and the louvred cabinet behind the cab, x 0.45 .. 1.15
the square equipment housing on the bed x -1.95 .. 0.05, roof z 2.60, with the turntable on its roof at x -0.95
the tall flat array 2.0 m wide, 2.85 m tall, raised on the turntable at x -0.95: lower edge z 3.05 (just over the cab roof), top z 5.90, plain face, module bays across its back
the outriggers angled out under the bed front, feet at x 0.05 .. 0.45, y +-1.62 .. +-2.02, and the jacks at the tail
two whip aerials on the cab's back corners at x 1.42, y +-1.02, standing to z 5.14
